verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, mechanics, and costs. Preserve unresolved fields as null.
research_scope: Kamehameha Boost — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared the seeded Strike Super index with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Kamehameha Boost was found. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Kamehameha Boost as a Strike Super Attack despite its Kamehameha projectile component.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Independent Xenoverse 2 documentation states that the Future Warrior can purchase Kamehameha Boost from the Skill Shop after defeating the Masked Saiyan and Masked Future Warrior in the main story. The current dedicated Xenoverse 2 skill page reports the acquisition field as TBA, so the story-gated Skill Shop route is retained as sourced historical/current documentation rather than promoted beyond the evidence.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented route is Skill Shop acquisition rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed sources do not establish a canonical stamina value.

records.name: Kamehameha Boost
records.character_source: Goku / Goku (GT) / Krillin, Goku (Super Saiyan God), and Goku (Super Saiyan 4) customizable partners
records.source_quest_or_shop: Skill Shop after defeating the Masked Saiyan and Masked Future Warrior in the main story
records.skill_description: Charge ahead while firing a Kamehameha behind you, using the blast and forward movement to slam into the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference classifies the move as a Strike Super with a faux-Ki-Blast and movement characteristic. The user turns and fires a Kamehameha while moving toward the opponent; the body movement can connect as a melee-style impact while the Kamehameha functions as an attack. Exact frame and hitbox behavior remains version-sensitive.
records.acquisition_notes: Independent Xenoverse 2 documentation reports Skill Shop acquisition after defeating both the Masked Saiyan and Masked Future Warrior in the main story. The dedicated skill page currently leaves its acquisition field TBA; this discrepancy is retained rather than silently normalized.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop route documented; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Strike Super with movement and faux-Ki-Blast characteristics; detailed matchup/frame interactions are version-sensitive.
